body:
STACK REBASED ONTO THE LANDED MetricObservation WORK, and this time there was a REAL conflict rather than a silent type break - worth reporting because it is the opposite failure from the one I have been warning about.

My four commits are now c63e91b, a0fbf01, cf037ba, 2255628 on m1/resolution, parent current main eda2d37. Everything below is unchanged in substance; only the rebase differs.

THE CONFLICT, and why it is the good kind: the scout's 8b36e32 changed UnitObservation's payload from Option[Double] to MetricObservation, and my route-honesty commit changed ClockPanel's fields to Option. Both edits land on ADJACENT LINES of the same LeakageSuite constructor, so git stopped and asked. Each side owned exactly one line - main's observations line, my clocks line - and the resolution was to take both. Thirty seconds, no judgement call.

CONTRAST WITH THE SignatureSuite CASE two hours ago: there, two actors appended to DIFFERENT REGIONS of one file while the types underneath moved, git merged cleanly, and the result did not compile. Here the edits were adjacent, git conflicted, and a human resolved it correctly. The dangerous case is not the conflict - it is the CLEAN MERGE. A conflict is a request for attention; a clean merge over moved types is a silent claim that no attention is needed. That is the argument for the one-sentence AGENTS.md addition I suggested earlier: run the module suite on the merged tree, because the merges that need it are precisely the ones that do not announce themselves.

EVIDENCE at 2255628, clean pin, gate last from the exact committed tree: alignJVM 153/153, alignJS 153/153, interviewJVM 75/75, embedBench 50/50 (the scout's 49 plus my ClockPanel renderer test coexisting), fixturesJVM 108/108, compileAll all three platforms, scalafmtCheckAll and scalafmtSbtCheck green.

STATE OF MY QUEUE, so you can sequence without asking: c63e91b + a0fbf01 are the align chronology/projection work that already went through the scout's BLOCK and rework and are waiting only on your gate. cf037ba is the relation-preservation P3. 2255628 is the placement-resolution vehicle, amended after the scout's second BLOCK and awaiting its re-review, not yours. Nothing in the stack is blocked on me.
